{{Quote|Who braves the flames of the Altar of Horror to stand in front of Lord Barel-Slathborn, Lord of the Sith?|Gargun|<ref name="The Spy" />}}
'''Gargun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who served in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Make sure you find an Imperial commander named Gargun. Can't imagine there will be more than one corpse in the temple wearing commander stripes.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Medle]]|<ref name="The Spy" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Gargun led a team into the [[Dark Temple]] but failed to return, leaving his subordinate [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Medle]] unable to prove his superior's death and thereby take his post. Medle therefore hired a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] during the galactic competition known as the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] to enter the Dark Temple and recover the commander's insignia, encountering Gargun who had been possessed by the ghost of [[Barel-Slathborn]]. However, the bounty hunter killed Gargun along with his [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] when he began to attack the hunter.<ref name="The Spy" />
